note: ALA-LC Modern Manipuri (Meitei script) Romanization Table, June 2022, pp. 1-2 (vowels, consonants, finals, visarga, anusvara, numerals); held source interscript-private-references/alalc/alalc-manipuri.pdf. Extraction: PDF text layer, every value cell cross-checked against the rendered page image. Vowel rows are transcribed as printed: the table pairs independent signs with romanization. Composite printed cells are transcribed as their printed composites: ꯑꯥ -> ā, ꯑꫵ -> aḥ, ꯁꯪ -> saṃ. Consonants are printed with inherent vowel "a"; final consonants are printed as a separate table (without inherent vowel) and transcribed as their own rows. Skipped printed rows: ꯬ (heavy tone) — printed value cell "◌̣" (a dot applied to the preceding vowel): a mark, not a standalone transliteration string; skipped as un-expressible. | ꯭ (apun iyek / "killer") — instruction cell (omits the preceding consonant's inherent vowel); no romanization value. | Punctuation marks ꫱, ꫰, ꯯ — the printed table names them (question mark, comma, full stop/period) but the value pairing in the text layer is layout-dependent; not transcribed as rows.
